the-cop-who-wasnt.title: A man in plain clothes with a badge told me to get in his unmarked car
the-cop-who-wasnt.description: At 2 a.m. an unmarked car flashed its lights and a man in plain clothes with a silver badge told me I was being detained and needed to get in his car. I refused, drove off, and the real police confirmed a man was impersonating an officer on that road. #truehorror #reallifehorror #ScaryTales

the-cop-who-wasnt.title: I heard someone picking the lock of the motel room next to mine
the-cop-who-wasnt.description: I was two doors down from a man working the locks of motel rooms with a piece of wire. I dragged a dresser against my door and climbed out the bathroom window to the office. They found him in another room the next week. #truehorror #reallifehorror #ScaryTales
